scope: Source-specific multiplane display QC for all 28 ASE/SCA publisher TEE recordings and all five existing local TEE alternatives.

method.metadata: ffprobe decoded stream dimensions, sample/display aspect ratios, frame counts and presentation timestamps; SHA-256 and exact byte count of the reviewed MP4 bytes.
method.pixelReview: ffmpeg source-frame extraction, SAR-corrected square-pixel frames, direct visual review of full sampled frames and native-dial crops.
method.sampleLimits: Publisher 01–14: first, middle and last decoded source frames. Publisher 15–28 and five local sources: first, middle and late (~90% requested duration), with actual decoded PTS recorded. Publisher 28 additionally has all 51 decoded native-dial frames visually inspected.
method.bounds: Manually reviewed native-dial boxes are conservative or approximate, as recorded in display-corrected pixels. They include the pointer, semicircle and current number; source labels remain untouched.
method.angleMeaning: Native values are transcriptions of the displayed scanner readout. REF values are guideline-range midpoints for teaching, not acquired or measured angles from these recordings.
method.clinicalLimit: This review does not establish anatomical correctness, acquisition calibration, CT registration, patient correspondence or clinical validation.
method.redistribution: This documentation contains source metadata and observations only. No downloaded publisher media, extracted frames or screenshots are included.

requiredFields: exact declared SHA-256 for the five local sources
sourceIdentityPolicy.unreviewedOrReplacedSource: No synthetic angle or REF explanation is assigned until the replacement source is reviewed.
sourceIdentityPolicy.runtimeHashBoundary: Local cache bytes are hash-verified. Publisher SHA-256 values in this review identify inspected bytes; the external video playback path does not hash publisher response bytes at runtime.
sourceIdentityPolicy.nativeBehavior: Retain the video-native angle display and existing source caption; hide the added SVG and REF explanation.
sourceIdentityPolicy.playbackBinding: Bind placement to the selected source identity, current request token and actual installed video URL, including a verified cache Blob URL. Require matching src/currentSrc and usable metadata. Clear bindings on replacement, cancellation, error and teardown; stale downloads or metadata cannot reactivate a prior angle.

sources.title: Midesophageal five-chamber

nativeDisplay.evidenceNotes: Full source frames at beginning, middle and late loop contain no visible multiplane semicircle or readable numeric angle. Small white caliper-like line with a green center to the right of the sector and a blue P marker are not a numeric multiplane display. No angle inferred from the view name or teaching range.

sources.inspectionCoverage: first, middle and last decoded source frames
sources.uncertaintyNote: Actual acquisition angle cannot be recovered from these pixels because no native angle is visible.

reference.label: REF
